fusions.name: Gallop Down
fusions.desc: A charging blow on a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to twice that at full reach. It always strikes critically, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Clip and Run
fusions.desc: A glancing kick that deals 5 damage and heals you for 15% of the damage dealt. For 3 seconds after using it, you move 10% faster.

fusions.name: Long Trot
fusions.desc: Increases your health recovery by 60% for 15 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 6 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Tireless Reserves
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
